_doc: A narrow, first-party allowlist for candidate-only change detection. Source Watch fetches only these exact public URLs, never follows returned links, never publishes findings, and never treats a page change as verified truth. Page text remains local and transient; tracked output contains hashes, source URLs, compact metadata, and review candidates only.

sources.name: Downtown Frederick Partnership events
sources.purpose: Detect material schedule or status changes on the Partnership's own downtown event board.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; do not republish page prose or media.

sources.name: Celebrate Frederick events
sources.purpose: Watch the organizer page for major City event changes, including seasonal festivals and concerts.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; do not republish page prose or media.

sources.name: The Great Frederick Fair schedule
sources.purpose: Detect schedule changes on the Fair's official event schedule.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; do not republish page prose, PDFs, or media.

sources.name: Visit Frederick events
sources.purpose: Watch the county destination organization's public event board for material changes.
sources.rightsPosture: Discovery and review only; existing publisher feeds remain the preferred ingestion path.

sources.name: Weinberg Center performances
sources.purpose: Use Firecrawl's rendered-page path for a first-party performance page that rejects a basic fetch.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; do not republish descriptions, artwork, or ticketing content.

sources.name: Sky Stage calendar
sources.purpose: Watch the Frederick Arts Council venue's JavaScript-backed calendar page.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; do not republish descriptions or media.

sources.name: Delaplaine Arts Center events
sources.purpose: Detect material changes on the arts center's own event page.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; the existing first-party calendar feed remains preferred.

sources.name: Maryland Ensemble Theatre events
sources.purpose: Detect material changes on the theatre's own event page.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; the existing first-party events API remains preferred.

sources.name: The Frederick Center events
sources.purpose: Watch the local nonprofit's public event page without touching private-location or registration-only details.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe public changes and link only; never infer or publish undisclosed locations.

sources.name: Maryland Deaf Community Center events
sources.purpose: Watch the organizer's public event page for Deaf-community programming changes.
sources.rightsPosture: Observe and link only; never infer accessibility accommodations that are not explicitly stated.

sources.name: City of Frederick emergency alerts
sources.purpose: Detect changes on the City's public CivicEngage emergency-alert page as a review signal.
sources.rightsPosture: Candidate-only cross-check; the official RSS feed remains authoritative for runtime display.

sources.name: Frederick County Health Department alerts
sources.purpose: Detect changes on the Health Department's public CivicEngage alert center as a review signal.
sources.rightsPosture: Candidate-only cross-check; official category RSS feeds remain authoritative.

sources.name: Frederick County Connector schedules
sources.purpose: Detect posted transit schedule or document changes on the County's official page.
sources.rightsPosture: Candidate-only cross-check; review linked documents and effective dates before any data update.

sources.name: Frederick County licensed mobile units roster
sources.purpose: Detect roster-page changes on the Health Department's official licensed mobile-units page.
sources.rightsPosture: Review signal only. Written reuse approval is still required before publishing roster-derived records.
